List of Nobel laureates

The prize is awarded each year by the committee to the persons who have conferred the greatest benefit on humankind in the field, and the committee publishes a long description of the work that earned the award together with the history of the prize and its rules.

Prize

As of 2025, the prize has been awarded to many individuals and organizations.[11] The first woman to receive a prize was Marie Curie, who received the prize in 1903.[11]

50-year secrecy rule

The committee neither informs the media nor the candidates themselves of the names of the nominees, and the nominations are kept secret for fifty years after the award.
